subject: Everything is read-only
body: This morning none of us can edit anything in Pharos. There's a banner saying the workspace is read-only. I think my card expired last week. I updated it an hour ago but we still can't edit, and my team is just sitting here.

subject: offline on the phone app
body: My crews work in buildings with no signal. Is there any way the mobile app can work offline and sync later? Right now they write stuff on paper and re-enter it.

subject: Due dates not on my Google Calendar
body: I connected my Google Calendar last week but none of my task due dates are showing up on it. I'd really like to see them next to my meetings.

subject: too many attempts
body: It says too many attempts and won't let me in. I'm presenting the project plan to a customer in 20 minutes and it's all in there.

subject: Nonprofit pricing?
body: We're a volunteer-run free clinic (501c3) using the trial to organize our outreach events. Is there any discount for nonprofits before we commit to a plan?

subject: emails going to junk
body: A couple of people on my team said the emails from Pharos land in their junk folder, so they miss when they're assigned something. Anything I can do?

subject: close account
body: Retiring at the end of the year. Please close my account and delete everything when the time comes. Thanks for the good service.

subject: video won't attach
body: I'm trying to attach a 250 MB video file to a task for client review and it just says Upload failed every time. Smaller images work fine.

subject: 400 emails overnight?!
body: Everyone on my team woke up to hundreds of Pharos emails, one for every single comment on our big launch project. People are furious and some are talking about turning email off entirely. What happened and how do I stop this?

subject: reuse our refund requests board
body: We have a project called Refund Requests with columns we really like. Can I reuse that setup for new projects so I don't rebuild it every time?

subject: Billed for wrong plan
body: We're on the Team plan but this month's invoice charged us $20 per person for Business. We never upgraded. Please correct it.

subject: Login I don't recognize
body: Under recent activity I see a login from another country at 2am yesterday. That wasn't me or anyone on my team. What should I do?

subject: Can I pay by invoice instead of card?
body: Our finance team wants to pay annually by bank transfer instead of a credit card. Is that possible and how do we set it up?

subject: Charged for 14 seats, we only have 9
body: Our latest invoice bills us for 14 seats but there are only 9 people in our workspace. We removed 5 people last month. Please refund the difference.

subject: Close our account
body: We've moved our projects to another tool and won't be renewing. Please cancel our subscription at the end of this billing period.

subject: GitHub PRs not linking to tasks
body: When we mention a task ID in a GitHub pull request it used to link automatically. Since Monday nothing links anymore. Did something change?

subject: Way too many emails
body: I'm getting an email for every single comment on every project. How do I turn these down to just things I'm assigned to?

subject: How do I make a project private?
body: I want a project only three of us can see while we plan a surprise for the rest of the team. How do I do that?

subject: File uploads failing
body: Every time I try to attach a PDF to a task I get 'Upload failed'. Images work fine. Client review is tomorrow and I need these files in.

subject: Locked out after new phone
body: I got a new phone and my authenticator app didn't transfer, so I can't get past two-factor. I have a deadline this afternoon. Please help me get back in.

subject: Adding a client as a guest
body: We want our client to see one project but not the rest of our workspace. Can we add them as a guest and does that cost a seat?

subject: Delete my personal data
body: I left Fischer Law last week. Under GDPR I'm asking you to delete my personal data from Pharos.

subject: Is Pharos down?
body: None of the boards are loading for anyone on my team, and two other agencies I know say the same. Just a spinning wheel.

subject: Possible XSS in task comments
body: Hi, I'm a security researcher. I found a way to run JavaScript through a crafted task comment. I'd like to report it responsibly. Who should I send details to?

subject: Gantt view?
body: Do you have a Gantt chart or timeline view? We'd really love one for production schedules.

subject: Questions before we sign up
body: We're a 12-person agency comparing tools. Do you offer a discount for annual billing and can we try the Business plan features during the trial?

subject: Just wanted to say thanks
body: Your new board templates saved us hours this week. The team loves them. No question, just a thank you!

subject: Get 10,000 leads this month
body: Hi there, we help SaaS companies like yours 10x their pipeline with our premium lead lists. Book a call this week for 50% off.

subject: Transfer ownership
body: I'm leaving the company and need to hand workspace ownership to my colleague Kate before Friday. How do I do that?

subject: Card declined, account suspended?
body: My card was declined on renewal and now we got an email saying the workspace will be suspended. I've added a new card. Will we lose anything?

subject: Export all our projects
body: We need a full export of every project and task for our records. What format do we get and how long does it take?

subject: Google Calendar not showing due dates
body: I connected Google Calendar but none of our task due dates show up. It's been a day. Am I missing a step?

subject: Tasks disappeared from a board
body: About 20 tasks vanished from our Launch board overnight. Nobody deleted them as far as we know. This is our main board for a launch next week.

subject: We're switching to a competitor unless this gets fixed
body: Third time this month notifications just stop for a whole day. We rely on them. If this happens again we're moving to another tool.

subject: Weird login from another country
body: I got an alert that someone logged into my account from a country I've never been to. I didn't do this. What should I do?

subject: Refund for annual plan we just bought
body: We bought the annual Team plan 10 days ago by mistake, we meant to pick monthly. Can we get a refund and switch?
